notes.title: Help Lost in its quest for the Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
Steam is hosting its annual game awards this year and I would like your support and votes in helping Lost achieve the Most Innovative Game of the Year award! Lost prides itself on being a game with a unique new mechanic to platforming and building off of that to create interesting and fun levels. The idea that movement hinders your vision of the screen makes for a challenging but refreshing take on traditional platforming and forces players to change the way they think about each level. I've put a lot of work into trying to make this mechanic both fair and challenging so that players can have an enjoyable time experiencing this while also perfecting their platforming. But it isn't just this one mechanic that makes the gameplay of Lost what it is. By combining this mechanic with well established platformer features such as portals and gravity switches, as well as plays on the new mechanic like the light switch, the game finds new life with each world as you build your experience and skills with each level you play.

I hope you've enjoyed the game that I have crafted and the thought that went into the unique mechanics it has displayed and can support Lost in its pursuit of the Most Innovative Game of the Year award!

notes.title: Fall Festival Lost Demo
notes.notes:
[h1]Get a Taste of Lost[/h1]

A new demo is being released for Lost, an atmospheric and emotional precision platformer! Test out the game's unique mechanic of darkening the world around you when you move, forcing the player to think ahead and react quickly to the hostile environment. This demo includes 9 levels, 3 from each of the first 3 worlds in the game. You can also try out the challenge mode which forces you to beat each level in record time, a fun challenge for those who take to the game easily or for speedrunners wanting to test their skills! If you enjoy the demo please wishlist the game so you can get it when it releases on October 13th! 

If you have any questions or comments about the demo you can email me at lostgamedeveloper@gmail.com and I'll be happy to help with any issues you run into or questions you have!
